nanananda_verbatim:
When one sees through wisdom, the world to be comparable to grass and
twigs.
plain_english_below: When one sees through wisdom, the world to be comparable to grass and twigs.
tts_line: When one sees through wisdom, the world to be comparable to grass and twigs.

nanananda_verbatim:
The internal earth element and the external earth element are both
just the earth element itself... 'This is not mine', 'I am not this',
'this is not my self'.
plain_english_below: The internal earth basic stuff and the external earth basic stuff are both just the earth basic stuff itself... 'This is not mine', 'I am not this', 'this is not my self'.
tts_line: The internal earth basic stuff and the external earth basic stuff are both just the earth basic stuff itself... 'This is not mine', 'I am not this', 'this is not my self'.

nanananda_verbatim:
Having seen thus with right wisdom, he becomes dejected with the earth
element, he detaches his mind from the earth element.
plain_english_below: Having seen thus with right wisdom, he becomes dejected with the earth basic stuff, he detaches his mind from the earth basic stuff.
tts_line: Having seen thus with right wisdom, he becomes dejected with the earth basic stuff, he detaches his mind from the earth basic stuff.

nanananda_verbatim:
Formerly, as brahmin youths, they were known as Upatissa and Kolita.
These two young men once went to see a hill-top festival... Since by
then, their discerning wisdom was already matured, they suddenly
developed a dejection about the entertainment going on. The hill-top
festival, as it were, lost its festivity for them.
plain_english_below: Formerly, as brahmin youths, they were known as Upatissa and Kolita. These two young men once went to see a hill-top festival... Since by then, their discerning wisdom was already matured, they suddenly developed a dejection about the entertainment going on. The hill-top festival, as it were, lost its festivity for them.
tts_line: Formerly, as brahmin youths, they were known as Upatissa and Kolita. These two young men once went to see a hill-top festival... Since by then, their discerning wisdom was already matured, they suddenly developed a dejection about the entertainment going on. The hill-top festival, as it were, lost its festivity for them.

nanananda_verbatim:
The fact that the mind-objects arise due to attention is noteworthy.
All the mind-objects mentioned in the fourth section of contemplation
arise when there is attention. And they go down when attention is not
there. In other words, attending makes objects out of them.
plain_english_below: The fact that the mind-objects arise due to attention is noteworthy. All the mind-objects mentioned in the fourth section of contemplation arise when there is attention. And they go down when attention is not there. In other words, attending makes objects out of them.
tts_line: The fact that the mind-objects arise due to attention is noteworthy. All the mind-objects mentioned in the fourth section of contemplation arise when there is attention. And they go down when attention is not there. In other words, attending makes objects out of them.

nanananda_verbatim:
With the idea of sharpening the razor, if one grabs it tightly and
rubs it on the sharpening stone, it will only become blunt. Paramasana,
grasping, grabbing, is something like that.
plain_english_below: With the idea of sharpening the razor, if one grabs it tightly and rubs it on the sharpening stone, it will only become blunt. Paramasana, holding on, grabbing, is something like that.
tts_line: With the idea of sharpening the razor, if one grabs it tightly and rubs it on the sharpening stone, it will only become blunt. Paramasana, holding on, grabbing, is something like that.

nanananda_verbatim: In whatever way his body is disposed, so he understands it.
plain_english_below: In whatever way his body is disposed, so he understands it.
tts_line: In whatever way his body is disposed, so he understands it.

nanananda_verbatim:
First: up, up, up, then: down, down, down, and then: up down, up down,
up down. The third combined movement ensures that those parts of the
blade still untouched by the stone will also get duly sharpened.
plain_english_below: First: up, up, up, then: down, down, down, and then: up down, up down, up down. The third combined movement ensures that those parts of the blade still untouched by the stone will also get duly sharpened.
tts_line: First — up, up, up, then — down, down, down, and then — up down, up down, up down. The third combined movement ensures that those parts of the blade still untouched by the stone will also get duly sharpened.

nanananda_verbatim:
There is a world of difference between them... But from the point of
view of realization, there is just a little difference. That spectrum of
the sun's rays in the dewdrop disappears with a very little shift in
one's perspective.
plain_english_below: There is a world of difference between them... But from the point of view of realization, there is just a little difference. That spectrum of the sun's rays in the dewdrop disappears with a very little shift in one's perspective.
tts_line: There is a world of difference between them... But from the point of view of realization, there is just a little difference. That spectrum of the sun's rays in the dewdrop disappears with a very little shift in one's perspective.

nanananda_verbatim:
If a train of thoughts had got started up about that gem, even through
a wrong concentration, at whatever moment radical attention comes on the
scene, complete reorientation occurs instantaneously.
plain_english_below: If a train of thoughts had got started up about that gem, even through a wrong concentration, at whatever moment radical attention comes on the scene, complete reorientation occurs instantaneously.
tts_line: If a train of thoughts had got started up about that gem, even through a wrong concentration, at whatever moment radical attention comes on the scene, complete reorientation occurs instantaneously.

nanananda_verbatim:
First of all one has to mindfully scan or scrutinize it... But based
on that scrutiny, the four right endeavours play their role in regard
to unskilful and skilful mental states.
plain_english_below: First of all one has to mindfully scan or scrutinize it... But based on that scrutiny, the four right endeavours play their role in regard to unskilful and skilful mental states.
tts_line: First of all one has to mindfully scan or scrutinize it... But based on that scrutiny, the four right endeavours play their role in regard to unskilful and skilful mental states.

nanananda_verbatim:
Here we have a wonderful technique, based on the twin principles of
pragmatism and relativity.
plain_english_below: Here we have a wonderful technique, based on the twin principles of pragmatism and relativity.
tts_line: Here we have a wonderful technique, based on the twin principles of pragmatism and relativity.

nanananda_verbatim:
Just as a blue lotus, born in the water, rises well above the water
and remains unsmeared — so the Tathagata dwells detached from ten
things with a mind unrestricted.
plain_english_below: Just as a blue lotus, born in the water, rises well above the water and remains unsmeared — so the Tathagata dwells detached from ten things with a mind unrestricted.
tts_line: Just as a blue lotus, born in the water, rises well above the water and remains unsmeared — so the Tathagata dwells detached from ten things with a mind unrestricted.

nanananda_verbatim:
One comes to know one's strongpoint, where one's forte lies...
One might recognize chanda, desire or interest, as one's strongpoint...
Another might discover that his true personality emerges in the thick
of striving... One who belongs to the wisdom category is never tired of
investigation.
plain_english_below: One comes to know one's strongpoint, where one's forte lies... One might recognize chanda, desire or interest, as one's strongpoint... Another might discover that his true personality emerges in the thick of striving... One who belongs to the wisdom category is never tired of investigation.
tts_line: One comes to know one's strongpoint, where one's forte lies... One might recognize chanda, desire or interest, as one's strongpoint... Another might discover that his true personality emerges in the thick of striving... One who belongs to the wisdom category is never tired of investigation.
